This is an instant five stars :-0. Okay so I have been struggling, STRUGGLING with chords so bad, I just want a simple free map or layout of all of them. I was hesitant at first on how you had to pay and was thinking it was something you had to do. Like Yousician or Simply Guitar… etcetera.
 To my surprise, I was embellished with every single chord in existence, including on higher frets! You have no idea how helpful it is to have all the chords layout to you for free, no payment, no extra bull. Its like a metronome y’know?
 You need a reference point to sound and tempo to understand your mistakes. I won’t be surprised if this app blows up one day or another. Anyways, wish the best to all of those new guitar players out there. Would recommend this to a beginner or higher level of player if you forget chord patterns. Can’t wait to see what will be done in the future for this app! :) (knowledge is a priceless thing)

reviews.text:
Favorite Chord App. Great app! I just got it, and it’s really easy to use and all the chords I’m looking for are there. I looked through the App Store for a very long time and downloaded several chord apps, but none of them worked out for me. This is by far the best one. This app really deserves much more attention. I have a quick suggestion though, and that is why I only gave 4 stars:

You should definitely be able to save certain chords. I like how simple the app is, but it’s one quick adjustment. This is because it come in handy if you have only a few specific chords your practicing and you want to get to them quickly.

Thank you! I hope you take this review into consideration. It would be much appreciated!
Outstanding. This is by far the most user-friendly chord library that I’ve found. Thank you for creating it.

Straightforward, no frills, exactly what you need!. This app provides a super streamlined approach to “the chord library”. No extra stuff, just correct and plainly written information to get you going. No distractions included. There are apps, but I would certainly pay for the app. The developer is a great musician, who is actively innovating his software, playing live shows, and making records. You can count on his company to continue doing great work like this when you invest in this app and his others. It’s truly a foolproof app, and doesn’t use any unnecessary power from your device either. Just instant information. All the other apps are similar! I use Music Tutor at all of my piano lessons. Highly recommended all around! Nicely done, JSplash!
Almost Perfect (for me). Only thing I would like to see is an option to view the notes and/or scale degrees of chords so as to better understand chord construction. Otherwise, great app.

A very comprehensive range of guitar chords. This app has a very wide and comprehensive range of guitar chords that can be easily viewed and heard.

What I was hoping to get from this app was chord recognition quizzes (where you’re shown a picture of a chord and you’ve to press the correct letter to accurately name the chord shown in the picture, and variations where you hear the chord and have to select the correct chord name and / or picture based on the chord you heard being played), as I find that quizzes where you’ve to think of the answer help you to learn each note and chord quicker than if you’re just shown the full details of the chord. 

So if quizzes like this could be added to either this app or your music tutor app, it’d be 5 stars from me!
